description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the CandidateOfferDecliningAPI in the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system. It tests methods related to declining candidate offers, including getOne(), getValidationRuleForGetOne(), update(), delete(), and getValidationRuleForDelete(). It includes setup routines, data providers, and mock configurations to facilitate testing the API's behavior.

classes.name: CandidateOfferDecliningAPITest
classes.description: JUnit test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase for testing the CandidateOfferDecliningAPI endpoints related to declining candidate offers within the recruitment module.

methods.description: Initializes test environment, truncating CandidateHistory table before each test.

methods.description: Tests that the getOne() method of CandidateOfferDecliningAPI throws a not implemented exception.
